facts.fact: 傍晚七点半，KRAY 坐在伦敦骑士桥 Berkeley Hotel 的 Blue Bar 吧台最右侧观察全场，并把外套搭在邻座替 LIFTSHITS 占位。
facts.anchor: The Blue Bar, The Berkeley Hotel, Knightsbridge, London, England, 7:30 in the evening.

facts.fact: 三名高个金发女郎踩着四英寸高跟鞋入场，酒吧里所有谈话停下，男士们全都盯着看。
facts.anchor: In stroll three tall blondes, made even taller by their four-inch heels.

facts.fact: LIFTSHITS 承认那三名女郎引起骚动，并说想不被注意就趁三人组进场时尾随而入。
facts.anchor: “They did cause a stir, didn’t they?” says LIFTSHITS.

facts.fact: LIFTSHITS 点 Maker’s Mark 曼哈顿：直调、柠檬皮、苦精、不加樱桃；KRAY 跟着点两杯。
facts.anchor: “Maker’s Mark Manhattan, straight up, perfect, twist of lemon, bitters, no cherry,” says LIFTSHITS.

facts.fact: LIFTSHITS 说 KRAY 的「Universal Imports」生意掩护不算坏、只是太泛，主张改成两个美国人在 Blue Bar 偶遇闲聊。
facts.anchor: “Well, that’s not a bad idea, even if it is a little generic,” says LIFTSHITS, smiling.

facts.fact: KRAY 说目标是 Division Chief P. Richard Wacker，LIFTSHITS 半低声骂出「Dick Wacker」，说讨厌此人、越来越喜欢这趟任务。
facts.anchor: “Dick Wacker!” LIFTSHITS blurts out in a half whisper.

facts.fact: KRAY 问 Cooper 给的伦敦 Funny Name 是否被部署过，LIFTSHITS 想了想摇头说从没听过这个名字。
KRAY 借服务门离场，门外等候的监视小组没看到他这次突然离开。
facts.anchor: The surveillance team waiting for him out front misses his surprise exit.
